title: Probe *.localhost via loopback so ngramx up still writes .ngramx.lock on WSL
description: On WSL2, ngramx up --avoid-conflicts can start a healthy namespaced stack, then hard-fail the docker.app_url probe because *.localhost does not resolve inside the distro. .ngramx.lock is never written. Probe via loopback, write the lock once the stack is up, and hint /etc/hosts without sudo.
